# Block chains: inputs and the port's outputs

The chains the port builds from block parameters (no chart code to compare against), run by [`tools/evidence.py`](../../tools/evidence.py) `chains` on the same inputs as [`tests/test_blocks.py`](../../tests/test_blocks.py); implementation in [`blocks.py`](../../src/qdrone_autoland/blocks.py).
